_comment: A/B control for the shape-prior experiment. Identical to lizard_heatmap_shape.json except model.variant is 'heatmap' (no projection). Run BOTH from this pair rather than comparing against an older run, so the only difference is the projection. Recipe matches alternative-models/hrnet/configs/heatmap_default.json, the setup that produced the established ~6.5px lizard heatmap number: 120 epochs, milestones [80,105], batch 32, sigma 5.0, differential head LR 1e-3 / backbone 1e-4. The engine routes lizard 'heatmap' through the differential-LR path (make_param_groups), so training.lr is the head LR and training.lr_backbone the backbone LR.
